sql_templates.description: Identify potential VCP or breakout candidates with fundamentals.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_stages AS (SELECT symbol, fundamental_score, trading_signal, max(snapshot_date) as snapshot_date
FROM scores.stage_snapshots
WHERE stage = 'STAGE_2' AND trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
GROUP BY symbol, fundamental_score, trading_signal),
latest_vcp AS (SELECT symbol, vcp_score, vcp_breakout_pct, max(snapshot_date) as snapshot_date
FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks
GROUP BY symbol, vcp_score, vcp_breakout_pct),
latest_eod AS (SELECT symbol, high, turnover_cr
FROM market.equity_eod
WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod))
SELECT ls.symbol
FROM latest_stages ls
JOIN latest_vcp lv ON ls.symbol = lv.symbol
JOIN latest_eod le ON ls.symbol = le.symbol
WHERE le.turnover_cr > 5
ORDER BY lv.vcp_score DESC, ls.fundamental_score DESC
LIMIT 50;

synthesis_guidance: ['Frame responses to neatly capture exceptions and data gaps.', 'Answer in the context of the Indian market, emphasizing pre-market analysis.']
title: VCP Breakouts With Fundamentals Variant 1374
